Initial release of searxng-search-cli.

- Provides a CLI tool to install, configure, and manage a self-hosted SearXNG meta search engine.
- Supports searching via multiple engines (Google, GitHub, Bing, etc.) through the command line or local API.
- Includes commands for installation, service management (start/stop/status), search queries, engine/language selection, and auto-start configuration.
- Features detailed usage documentation and troubleshooting instructions in both English and Chinese.
